verdicts.reason: Both are crammed leaderboards. The RSVP CTA is shrunk to the size of the badge pills and buried in a 2x2 cluster, the italic tagline is squeezed into a 6–7 line column of tiny text, the legal copy is illegible, and the missing-asset placeholder still shows at the right edge. A drops the product can entirely and shrinks the Solstice logo to a near-invisible mark at far left. Its one-line headline is strong, but the brand and key imagery are lost. B keeps the logo under 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' and keeps a (tiny) can, but wraps the headline onto two smaller lines and leaves dead space around the logo.
